scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n crm-api,crm-web,whatsapp "npm run dev:mysql --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "PORT=3100 npm --prefix whatsapp-plugin run dev"
scripts.app:personal: node scripts/run-with-profile.mjs personal npm run dev:services
scripts.app:dev: node scripts/run-with-profile.mjs development npm run dev:services
scripts.db:migrate:personal: node scripts/run-with-profile.mjs personal npm run db:migrate:mysql --workspace backend
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node scripts/run-with-profile.mjs development npm run db:migrate:mysql --workspace backend
scripts.test:mysql: node scripts/run-with-profile.mjs test npm run test:mysql:suite --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm --prefix whatsapp-plugin run build
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm --prefix whatsapp-plugin test
